methods.cohort: Only the established pooled dark/bar/bar-jump VES041 no-heat cohort. Heat cohort not loaded or analyzed.
methods.selection: >30 deg net unwrapped recorded heading change in ~1 s; <=2 mm net XY displacement; net/accumulated absolute heading change >=0.7. Sliding starts every ~0.1 s, rounded to available imaging-aligned frames. Overlapping/touching qualifying windows merged. No slowdown or 2-s refractory requirement.
methods.alignment: Center of the representative 1-second window with greatest net rotation within each merged bout. This is not a neural peak, slowdown time, or experimentally measured turn onset.
methods.comparator: Saved original imaging-rule slowdown+rotation events on exactly the same available recordings, restricted only to common complete heading/XY/fluorescence/behavior validity.
methods.comparator_alignment: Strongest deceleration. Latencies cannot be directly compared across definitions because their alignment anchors differ.
methods.fluorescence: Original stored dF/F; no peak/amplitude selection, added baseline subtraction, z-score, or extra smoothing. Linear display interpolation onto -2:0.05:+3 s, matching original figures.
methods.validity: Full -2:+3 s event epochs must be finite and behavior-valid without time gaps. No heat state, no opto state, no added visual/bar-jump exclusion.
methods.sampling: Use recorded heading and XY at the saved imaging-aligned behavioral rate, without inventing a 100-Hz stream. Lower sampling can alter directionality estimates compared with the inhibition data.
methods.pooling: Pool events over recordings within each mapped fly; equal weight per contributing fly. SEM is pointwise sample SD across fly means divided by sqrt(n). Zero-event flies are excluded for that definition, not replaced by zeros.
methods.missing_data: Two older figure-only recordings lack recoverable saved actual heading. They remain explicitly unassessable, not substituted by integration of yaw.
methods.identities: Existing fly mapping retained, including inferred identities. See original dark_bar_barjump_fly_mapping.csv and source metadata.
methods.statistics: Descriptive plots only. No new hypothesis tests.
